$description: HeatMap (platform/charts/HeatMap.jsx, heat-map.css; library wave 9, lane A): its component tokens. Cell colors are the data-viz sequential and diverging scales (data-plx-dataviz); everything else is an existing role.

heat-map-cell-radius.$description: Heat map: the corners of a cell.

heat-map-cell-border-width.$description: Heat map: the width of a cell's edge (an empty cell's dashed edge).

heat-map-empty-background.$description: Heat map: the inside of a cell with no value.

heat-map-empty-border-color.$description: Heat map: the dashed edge of a cell with no value.

heat-map-empty-dash.$description: Heat map: the dash and gap of an empty cell's edge.

heat-map-active-border-color.$description: Heat map: the edge of the cell in focus or under the pointer.

heat-map-active-border-width.$description: Heat map: the width of the active cell's edge.

heat-map-scale-gap.$description: Heat map: the space between the scale's ends, its steps and the missing value's key.

heat-map-scale-text.$description: Heat map: the scale's values and the missing value's name.

heat-map-scale-font-family.$description: Heat map: the scale's words (UI text).

heat-map-scale-value-font-family.$description: Heat map: the scale's lowest and highest values: the data font.

heat-map-scale-label-font-family.$description: Heat map: the missing value's name in the scale (UI text).

heat-map-scale-font-size.$description: Heat map: the scale's size (the tick labels' size).

heat-map-scale-line-height.$description: Heat map: the scale's line height.

heat-map-scale-swatch-width.$description: Heat map: the width of one step of the scale.

heat-map-scale-swatch-height.$description: Heat map: the height of the scale's steps (and the side of the missing value's key).
